OCHECK.description: Steel Optimal Design / Section Check (OCHECK) for AIJ-ASD02. The ODS_RUN_REQUEST DTO (wrapped in Argument) gives a required section list plus optional analysis, column-design, output, plate-thickness and user-defined-section blocks. Same handler as the KDS OCHECK; the active design code (set via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO) determines the code rules used. Runs SYNCHRONOUSLY and can re-run the structural analysis up to ANAL_TIME times, so a large model easily exceeds the ~60s client read timeout. SIDE EFFECTS: OUTPUT.MODEL_UPDATE=true MODIFIES the model (replaces member sections with the optimal ones), and OUTPUT with a non-empty EXPORT_PATH writes graph/report files on the HOST machine; omit OUTPUT (or leave EXPORT_PATH empty) for a pure query. Every SECT_LIST[].SECT_NO must reference an existing model section or the request fails in-band ('Section N does not exist.'). Response: {FORCE, DIST, HEAD, DATA} table with columns No, Name, Size, Area, COM, Axial, Ben-y, Ben-z, Shear; a '*' prefix on Size marks a section that was NOT selected, and a '*' prefix on COM marks a slender section.

SECT_LIST.description: Section List & Design Criteria. Each entry references an existing section and its optimal-design criteria. Omitted SHAPE/D1..D6 fall back to the model section's shape/dimensions.

SECT_NO.description: Section No. Must reference an existing section in the model (otherwise the request fails).

SECT_DB.description: Section DB. Case-insensitive. BUILT requires PLATE_THICKNESS; USER requires the section number to be defined in USER_DEFINED_SECT.

SHAPE.description: Shape (L=angle, C=channel, H, T, B=box, P=pipe, SR=round bar, SB=square bar, 2L, 2C). Case-insensitive. If omitted, the model section's shape is used.

D1.description: Section dimension D1. If omitted, the model section's dimension is used.

D2.description: Section dimension D2. If omitted, the model section's dimension is used.

D3.description: Section dimension D3. If omitted, the model section's dimension is used.

D4.description: Section dimension D4. If omitted, the model section's dimension is used.

D5.description: Section dimension D5. If omitted, the model section's dimension is used.

D6.description: Section dimension D6. If omitted, the model section's dimension is used.

ANAL_TIME.description: Analysis Time (number of re-analysis iterations). 0 = section selection only (no re-analysis), max 10. Higher values multiply run time - mind the ~60s client timeout.

APPLIED_FORCES.description: Applied Forces and Moments (0=Axial+Moments, 1=Axial Only). Any other value fails in-band with 'APPLIED_FORCES must be 0 or 1'.

JOINT_METHOD.description: Joint Method of Built-Up Column Splices (0=Internal, 1=External). Any other value fails in-band with 'JOINT_METHOD must be 0 or 1'.

OUTPUT.description: Output Options. File output is produced only when this block is present AND EXPORT_PATH is non-empty; files are written on the HOST machine. WARNING: MODEL_UPDATE=true is side-effectful - it updates the model's sections to the optimal result.

MODEL_UPDATE.description: Model Update. SIDE EFFECT: true replaces the model's member sections with the optimal-design result. Keep false for a read-only check.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Export Path on the HOST machine (folder or prefix). If empty, no file output is produced.

PLATE_THICKNESS.description: Plate Thickness Data. Required when any SECT_LIST entry uses SECT_DB = BUILT.

USER_DEFINED_SECT.description: User-Defined Section DB. Required when any SECT_LIST entry uses SECT_DB = USER (entries are matched by NO).

NO.description: No (user section number, matched against SECT_LIST[].SECT_NO).
